The subject must be structurally legible and richly detailed, not a flat vector icon, not a toy, no glow, no orbit lines, no labels, no arrows, no axes, no ground plane or cast shadow. A small dusty-rose residue patch on the upper-right face. Genuine dense folded structural-biology cartoon, no enormous empty outer loops. No RNA/DNA/ligand.
